name: Star-Dusted Banana Crunch 1.15oz
description:
Star-Dusted Banana Crunch isn’t your ordinary banana snack—it’s a galaxy of flavor and texture in every bite. We start with ripe banana slices, gently freeze-dried to preserve their natural sweetness and transform them into light, crispy wonders. Then we add a delicate drizzle of cinnamon-sugar magic, giving each piece a warm, spiced glow that’s straight from the stars.

Whether you're chasing constellations or just craving something delightfully different, these crunchy banana bites offer the perfect blend of cozy and cosmic. No mess, no fuss—just clean, sweet fuel with a stellar twist. It’s like banana bread took a rocket ship to space and came back with a crunch.

Take a bite, make a wish, and let the cinnamon stardust carry you away.

name: Apple Cinnamon Comets 1.15oz
description:
Apple Cinnamon Comets are sweet, spiced stardust in snack form—crafted from crisp green apples and gently freeze-dried to preserve their bold crunch and vibrant flavor. Each slice is lightly dusted with a celestial blend of brown sugar, cane sugar, and cinnamon, creating a warm, cozy balance of tart and sweet that feels like a cosmic hug.

Perfect for autumn dreamers, winter snackers, or anyone craving a nostalgic taste with an out-of-this-world twist, Apple Cinnamon Comets are your ticket to an orchard orbit. Whether you're exploring galaxies or just your afternoon cravings, these comet-inspired crisps are the perfect snack to keep your taste buds grounded—and your imagination soaring.

name: Aurora Berryalis 2.6oz
description:
Blast off into bold berry bliss with Aurora Berryalis—a freeze-dried wild berry explosion that’s light, crunchy, and irresistibly intense. Each vibrant piece captures the colors and flavors of a dancing aurora, transformed through freeze-drying into a crackly, melt-in-your-mouth treat that defies gravity. Bursting with intergalactic energy, this cosmic candy is perfect for adventurous snackers and flavor chasers who crave a journey beyond the ordinary.

Let your taste buds travel among the stars with every bite.

name: Sour Aurora Bites 2.6oz
description: Summoned from the stars and kissed with tart magic, Sour Aurora Bites deliver a spellbinding crunch and a sour-sweet burst that leaves you craving more. Not your average Aurora Bite—these are cosmic candy alchemy.

name: Solar Strawberries 0.5oz
description: These aren’t your average strawberries—Solar Strawberries are interstellar snacks powered by pure berry energy. Sweet, tart, and irresistibly crunchy, they’re like a supernova in every bite.

name: Cosmic Bananas 1.55oz
description: Launched from the bunch and straight into orbit, Cosmic Bananas are freeze-dried bites of sweet banana magic with a satisfying crunch and zero gravity guilt.

name: Aurora Bites 2.6oz
description: Aurora Bites are crunchy rainbow bursts from another dimension. Each piece delivers a kaleidoscope of fruity flavor and a stellar snap that’s light-years beyond ordinary candy.

name: Apple Zephyr Chips 1.15oz
description: Whisper-light and kissed by the wind, Apple Zephyr Chips are crisp apple slices transformed by the stars. Each bite is a breezy crunch of orchard sweetness with a spell of celestial charm.
